cases.observation: Published darwin-arm64 archive staged in an isolated HOME. setup --harness codex and doctor succeeded; doctor reported no problems and Codex/ACP/code-mode-host ready. The candidate secretaryd process ran from the extracted published archive on 127.0.0.1:18081; health returned status ok and binary revision matched the release target. Existing alpha.17 Server on port 8081 was not touched.

Published co-located Node was configured and paired to the isolated candidate Server using the temporary environment credential. Inventory returned one online Node alpha18-mac-alpha18 at capacity 1; Node doctor reported paired identity and Codex/ACP ready. The running Node executable and revision matched the published darwin-arm64 archive.

A real owner-authenticated message was accepted (HTTP 202), but the Secretary entry was the failure response: 'Secretary не получил подтверждённый адресованный ответ. Выполнение запроса не подтверждено; проверьте доступность Secretary MCP и состояние задачи перед повторной попыткой.' No direct answer or Worker was created. This is a live failure of the positive Secretary turn; no retry or workaround was attempted.
Not attempted: the real Secretary turn failed and created no Worker. Per the acceptance workflow, no downstream dispatch was fabricated or retried.
